title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Limiting the Available Product Languages

chapters.title: New administrator capability for allowed languages
User experience with filtered language list

features.name: Allowed languages administration
features.description: Administrators can limit the product languages available to users by specifying which languages users can choose from in their personal settings, reducing confusion from the full list of available languages.

quotes.text: we'll show you another Nifty little addition to Business Center 2025 wave 1 developed by one of our community members

quotes.why_it_matters: Core description of the new administrative capability to restrict language options.

quotes.text: if you go into my settings the user will only be able to choose from the languages which are allowed
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the user-facing impact of the administrator's language restrictions.
